modelAnswer:
[Date]

To: The Owner
[Company Name]

Subject: Resignation from My Present Position and Application for Approval to Join the Pilot Service

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to tender my resignation from my present position with [Company Name], as I have decided to pursue a new career as a maritime pilot. After careful consideration, I believe that this new appointment will allow me to make better use of my seafaring experience, navigational knowledge and ship-handling skills, while also providing an opportunity for professional development and service to the maritime community.

During my employment with the Company, I have gained valuable experience and received considerable support from the management and my colleagues. I am sincerely grateful for the opportunities and guidance that have contributed to my professional growth. My decision is not the result of any dissatisfaction with the Company, but rather a carefully considered career choice.

I therefore respectfully request your kind approval for my resignation and for my acceptance of the new post as a pilot. I will do my best to complete all necessary handover arrangements and outstanding duties in an orderly manner, and to cooperate fully in accordance with the Company's requirements and applicable notice period.

Thank you very much for your understanding and kind consideration. I wish the Company continued success in the future.

Yours faithfully,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
practicalAnalysis: 本題要求寫給船東（owner）的辭職信，核心不是一般求職信，而是正式提出離職、交代轉任引水人的原因，並請求船東批准。建議採正式商務書信格式：日期、收件人、主旨、稱謂、辭職與轉職原因、感謝任職期間的支持、明確請求批准、交接承諾及結尾敬語。理由可寫成職涯發展、運用航海資歷與操船經驗、服務港口航運安全；避免批評原公司或暗示未經批准已逕行離職。英文用語以 tender my resignation、pursue a new career、maritime pilot、request your kind approval、handover arrangements 為主。

keyPoints.point: 明確向船東提出辭去現職（tender my resignation）。
清楚說明決定轉任引水人（to take up / join a new post as a maritime pilot）。
交代正面且合理的轉職原因，例如職涯發展、運用航海與操船經驗、貢獻港口航行安全。
明確請求船東核准（request your kind approval），不可只寫通知對方。
感謝公司與同事過去的支持，維持專業、尊重的語氣。
承諾依契約及公司規定完成預告、職務交接與未了事項。

references.title: 94年引水人考試專業英文第1題原題
references.supports: 原題要求向船東提出辭職、說明轉任引水人的理由並請求批准。

references.title: 商務英文正式書信慣例：辭職信應明確表達辭職意旨、理由、感謝及交接安排；本題未提供特定公司名稱、日期、職位或離職日，故以方括號作為可替換欄位。

assumptions: 以船員寫給船東／船公司負責人的正式英文書信為情境。
題目未提供具體離職日期、船名、公司名稱及收件人姓名，故不虛構資料。
limitations: 此為符合題意的示範書信，非考選部公布的標準答案；實際離職仍應依僱傭契約及適用法令辦理。

checks.item: 題目要求完整涵蓋辭職、轉任引水人、說明理由及請求批准
未虛構考生個人資料或公司資訊

modelAnswer: As a total solar eclipse took place on Friday, a blanket of darkness fell over much of Indonesia and the southern Philippines. Among the thousands of people who witnessed the scene, some prayed, some cheered, and others beat drums.\n\nA partial solar eclipse could also be seen in areas extending from India in the west, across Southeast Asia, mainland China and Japan, to New Guinea, as well as parts of Australia and the Pacific islands.
practicalAnalysis: 本題為中翻英新聞敘述，重點是天文現象與群眾反應的自然表達。全日蝕應譯 total solar eclipse，不可直譯成 all-day eclipse；日偏蝕為 partial solar eclipse。a blanket of darkness fell over 是描述大範圍陷入黑暗的自然新聞用語；much of Indonesia and the southern Philippines 保留「大部分地區」的範圍語意。群眾反應可用 some prayed, some cheered, and others beat drums，呈現排比。最後一句用 extending from...to...表達可見區域的地理延伸，並以 as well as 補充澳洲及太平洋部分島嶼。

keyPoints.point: 全日蝕＝total solar eclipse；日偏蝕＝partial solar eclipse。
「一片黑幕籠罩」可譯 a blanket of darkness fell over，避免逐字直譯。
「印尼及南菲律賓大部分地區」＝much of Indonesia and the southern Philippines。
「有人祈禱、有人歡呼，也有人擊鼓」用平行結構 some..., some..., and others...。
「遠自西邊的印度……都可見到」可用 areas extending from India in the west ... to...。
mainland China用來表達中國大陸，避免與島嶼或其他地區混淆。

references.title: 94年引水人考試專業英文第2題原題
references.supports: 中翻英原題及全日蝕、日偏蝕可見範圍的中文敘述。

references.title: NASA – Solar Eclipses
references.supports: 核對 total solar eclipse 與 partial solar eclipse 等天文現象英文名稱。

assumptions: 依考題中文內容忠實翻譯，不另行推定該次日蝕的確切日期或重新判定可見範圍。
「成千群眾」依語意譯為 thousands of people。
limitations: 題目未提供新聞原文或事件日期；答案以中文題幹為唯一翻譯依據，不對歷史天文事件另作事實校訂。

checks.item: 全日蝕與日偏蝕專業英文術語
checks.note: 採total solar eclipse及partial solar eclipse。
保留印尼、南菲律賓、印度、東南亞、中國大陸、日本、新幾內亞、部分澳洲及太平洋島嶼。
採自然新聞敘述及平行結構，未增加題幹以外的事件資訊。

modelAnswer:
(1) 危機處理 — **crisis management**
Sentence: Effective crisis management is essential when a ship is involved in a serious accident.

(2) 舉證責任 — **burden of proof**
Sentence: The burden of proof rests with the party making the allegation.

(3) 職業安全 — **occupational safety**
Sentence: The company must provide proper training and equipment to ensure occupational safety on board.

(4) 鋒面雨 — **frontal rain** / **rain associated with a front**
Sentence: Frontal rain may reduce visibility and make pilotage operations more difficult.

(5) 法律規定的 — **statutory** / **prescribed by law**
Sentence: The master must comply with the statutory requirements for the safe operation of the vessel.

(6) 分道航行規劃 — **traffic separation scheme (TSS)**
Sentence: Vessels navigating in a traffic separation scheme should proceed in the appropriate traffic lane and follow the applicable routing rules.

(7) 易變天氣 — **changeable weather** / **unsettled weather**
Sentence: The pilot should take extra care when navigating in changeable weather conditions.

(8) 引水法條款 — **provisions of the Pilotage Act**
Sentence: The pilot must perform his duties in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Pilotage Act.

(9) 迴轉穩定器 — **gyroscopic stabilizer** (also: **gyro stabilizer**)
Sentence: A gyroscopic stabilizer can reduce a ship's rolling motion in certain operating conditions.

(10) 自動調整拖纜機 — **automatic-tension towing winch** / **automatic tension-controlled towing winch**
Sentence: The tug is fitted with an automatic-tension towing winch to help maintain the required tension in the towline.
practicalAnalysis: 第(6)題雖依中文題幹寫作「分道航行規劃」，COLREG Rule 10的正式制度名稱是Traffic Separation Schemes，臺灣常用法規譯名為「分道通航制」，答題應以traffic separation scheme (TSS)為主。第(10)題美國海軍拖帶手冊使用automatic towing machinery等設備術語，IALA詞典對towing winch的定義則涵蓋拖纜收放及自動控制；本答案以automatic tension towing machine (ATM)作主譯，並列constant-tension towing winch等依機型而異的可接受說法。

keyPoints.point: 危機處理＝crisis management；須用名詞片語。
舉證責任＝burden of proof；常用搭配the burden of proof rests with...。
職業安全＝occupational safety。
鋒面雨＝frontal rain，亦可用rain associated with a front。
法律規定的＝statutory或prescribed by law，依句法選用。
分道航行規劃＝traffic separation scheme (TSS)，為COLREG Rule 10的重要制度用語。
易變天氣＝changeable weather或unsettled weather。
引水法條款＝provisions of the Pilotage Act。
迴轉穩定器按陀螺減搖裝置解讀為gyroscopic stabilizer，勿與fin stabilizer混淆。
自動調整拖纜機依自動控制拖纜張力功能譯為automatic-tension towing winch。

references.supports: 原題要求翻譯十個中文海事／法律詞彙並各造完整英文句子。

references.supports: traffic separation scheme (TSS)及船舶遵循分道航行制的規範用語。

references.supports: 職業安全相關海事語境；詞彙本身採通用專業英文。

references.supports: 說明automatic towing machinery、towing winch與traction machine等術語，並列出拖帶機械的收放拖纜、調整拖纜長度及緊急釋放功能。

references.issuer: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
references.pageOrSection: Section 3, Constant Tension Winch and Render-Recovery Winch
references.supports: 說明constant-tension winch可自動收放拖纜以維持預設張力，並比較傳統拖纜機與自動張力控制機械。

references.issuer: International Association of Marine Aids to Navigation and Lighthouse Authorities (IALA)
references.supports: 提供towing winch的海事術語定義，說明其捲收拖纜，並通常配有依拖帶天候與負荷自動放纜或收纜的控制系統。

references.title: TERMIUM Plus – Gyro stabilizer / Gyroscopic stabilizer
references.supports: 核對船舶陀螺減搖設備的標準英文名稱gyro stabilizer及gyroscopic stabilizer。

references.title: 1972年國際海上避碰規則公約暨避碰規則（中英對照節錄／1989修正）
references.issuer: 雙語參考譯本（非官方網站鏡像）
references.pageOrSection: Rule 10 — Traffic Separation Schemes / 第10條 分道通航制
references.supports: 供核對COLREG英文Rule 10與中文「分道通航制」對照；英文法規仍以IMO官方COLREG頁面及正式公約文本為準，此雙語檔僅作學習比對。

assumptions: 第(9)題「迴轉穩定器」按船舶陀螺減搖裝置理解；若原出題教材指其他旋轉式穩定設備，應依該設備型式調整。
第(10)題按拖船拖纜張力自動控制型絞纜機理解；各製造商可能使用automatic tension winch或constant-tension winch等不同名稱。
limitations: 第(9)、(10)題屬設備名稱，原題未附圖、設備型號或英文參考書目，正式設備名稱仍應以船舶設備手冊及製造商術語核對。
句子為考試作答示範，採簡潔完整句型；並非官方公布答案。

checks.item: 十個詞組皆提供英文對應及完整英文例句

checks.note: traffic separation scheme為國際避碰規則Rule 10的標準名稱。
政府加拿大TERMIUM Plus確認gyro stabilizer及gyroscopic stabilizer均為船舶陀螺減搖設備正確術語；與fin stabilizer區分。

checks.item: 自動調整拖纜機製造商術語
checks.note: 依美國海軍拖帶手冊及IALA海事詞典，採automatic tension towing machine (ATM)作主譯，automatic tension towing winch作可接受變體；不同拖帶機型的自動張力控制方式仍有差異。

checks.item: 第(6)題中文制度名稱與COLREG Rule 10
checks.note: traffic separation scheme (TSS)為COLREG Rule 10正式英文名稱；中文考試題幹用語「分道航行規劃」應補充與正式制度名稱「分道通航制」的關係，避免誤以為是航線規劃文件。

checks.item: 第(10)題自動調整拖纜機主譯
checks.note: 以automatic tension towing machine (ATM)作主譯，並依具體設備控制方式列constant-tension towing winch及automatic-tension towing winch為變體；不將所有自動張力拖纜機視為相同機構。
